name: Interactive Studio, Panes, and Navigation
description: A source-backed parent view of workspace loading, pane composition, diagram interaction, evidence reveal navigation, and the browser-to-application service boundary.

codeEntities.label: App and revealCodeEntity
codeEntities.summary: Selects the browser page and coordinates studio-level cross-pane evidence reveals from mapped diagram elements.

codeEntities.label: fetchWorkspace
codeEntities.summary: Loads the complete workspace snapshot from the browser API without using a cached response.

codeEntities.label: WorkspaceSnapshot
codeEntities.summary: Aggregates projects, DiagramSets, evidence, artifacts, runs, mappings, and refinement state for the studio UI.

codeEntities.label: createStudioPaneState
codeEntities.summary: Builds or normalizes the files, primary, and context pane topology using the active domain profile and restored layout.

codeEntities.label: PaneLayoutState
codeEntities.summary: Stores the pane split tree, pane records, and currently focused pane.

codeEntities.label: PaneApi
codeEntities.summary: Provides the mutable command surface for creating, focusing, tabbing, moving, and resizing panes.

codeEntities.label: PaneWorkspace
codeEntities.summary: Recursively renders PaneLayoutState and supplies PaneApi to pane frames and split nodes.

codeEntities.label: FileExplorerPanel
codeEntities.summary: Builds the repository file tree and rolls DiagramSet evidence labels onto matching source nodes.

codeEntities.label: DiagramView
codeEntities.summary: Coordinates diagram rendering, revision-safe evidence mappings, selections, references, highlighting, and edit interactions.

codeEntities.label: AsciiSelectionGrid
codeEntities.summary: Renders ASCII as an interactive coordinate grid and turns mapped spans into evidence-reveal controls.

codeEntities.label: DiagramElementMapping
codeEntities.summary: Links one visible ASCII coordinate span to a CodeEntity and a stable or indexed source range.

codeEntities.label: PaneNavigationApi
codeEntities.summary: Activates and focuses destination panes, retains jump history, and delivers typed jumps to registered feature handlers.

codeEntities.label: CodeEntitiesPanel
codeEntities.summary: Selects evidence entities and ranges, responds to navigation jumps, and loads source or document previews.

codeEntities.label: fetchSourceSnippet
codeEntities.summary: Requests a selected CodeEntity source range through the browser API and returns its source-preview payload.

codeEntities.label: DiagramApplication.sourceSnippet
codeEntities.summary: Resolves a DiagramSet CodeEntity range against its corpus and overlays its captured source snapshot for display.
